## Link checks first

236 tracked files yielded 1,369 distinct external URL candidates, 140 relative-path candidates and 38 mailto/tel links. All 1,369 external candidates were attempted: 1,182 returned HTTP success and 187 reader errors. These counts include historical material, examples and extraction artefacts. HTTP success does not validate fragments, soft-404 pages, the underlying claims, login-gated forms or accepted languages. 139 relative candidates resolve; the remaining candidate is a code-regex false positive, not a missing file. Mailto/tel destinations were not contacted. Fragment and exhaustive semantic-link verification remain incomplete.

Raw attempts: [link-results.jsonl](link-results.jsonl). Grouped browser requests with URLs and observed errors: [reader-failures.md](reader-failures.md). Preserve last-good evidence; never bulk-replace historical links solely from reader failures.

## Validation and pilot readiness

The existing offline state helper was used for structured first observations and repeat-batch idempotence in an isolated EU27 namespace. First readable observations are baselines, not new-change alerts. Existing pilot source facts, candidates and monthly coverage remain intact. No persistent-failure count was invented for a new source ID.

The full country validator already failed on unchanged main with Evidence fingerprint mismatch. Existing fingerprints were not rewritten to bypass that blocker. Targeted checks must establish new evidence IDs, schemas, routing, unchanged claims/public pages and regression outcomes before branch publication. See validation.txt for actual results.

This pass is not a maintainer-approved five-page pilot sample. Human review, outstanding archive/intake checks, full monthly coverage and the inherited validator defect remain blockers to declaring the pilot complete or promoting upstream. No token, monetary-cost or historic run-duration metrics are invented. Runtime start was 08:51:32 UTC; authoritative finish is in watcher operational state.
